list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase in November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; the sources named beside each guide are where its facts come from.
note: Grand Theft Auto VI launched 19 November 2026. Where a guide says a step is not yet verified in game, that is stated honestly in the guide itself. No online trophies exist in this list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task behind it and no multiplayer or DLC is needed, so the whole hunt is the 54 trophies below. PowerPyx puts the full run at roughly 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, with a single playthrough enough, and notes that the hardest single step is the gold trophy A Long Road for 100% completion. Keep this list open from the start so the long grinds (stunts, vehicles, challenges) build up naturally while you play.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it pops when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Play the opening mission through to its end and the trophy unlocks automatically. PowerPyx confirms it is an automatic story trophy tied to that first mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and it pops as the chapter closes (PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it arrives a beat late). Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — the one trophy-related interaction in the game that can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it pops when you finish Chapter 2, which PowerPyx says closes after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Just keep playing the pink main-mission icons in order. Chapter 2 is also when character switching opens up after Breakfast Run, so the partner trophies become possible from here on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish Chapter 3 and it pops as Chapter 4 begins (PowerPyx: after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life). Chapter 3 is a good time to start the side-character questlines that open here — Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's — since their final missions each carry their own trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it pops when you finish Chapter 4, after its final main mission, Starting From Zero. The same mission also closes the story arc that the gold final-mission trophy belongs to, so expect two pops close together at the end of this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish the final mission of the game (Chapter 5, Operation Savage Glory) and this gold pops. PowerPyx lists it as automatic and unmissable. After the credits you return to free-roam, so everything left for the platinum — the 100% checklist, Strangers & Freaks and the clean-up trophies — is still available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. This mission matters beyond its own trophy — PowerPyx notes that switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, which is what makes the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) possible at all.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission, so it pops automatically when the mission ends. No preparation is needed — just play the story in order.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it unlocks automatically at the end of that mission, so there is nothing extra to do or watch for.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It pops automatically when the mission ends. Keep playing the story missions in order and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It unlocks automatically at the end of the mission. The airport is also the setting of the separate free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so you will come back here later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx lists it as the final story mission of the game, so this trophy and the gold final-mission trophy pop at the same point, right before the credits and the return to free-roam.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players will earn. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable, so it can all be finished in free-roam. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, most side quests are not required, and collectibles are usually only partly required. The lenient targets are 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 300 stunts, any 100 optional missions, all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults and all 15 target decks. Work on the other trophies first and most of the checklist fills itself in.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — you may mix the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 parachute base jumps. PowerPyx says flying under bridges is the quickest kind to clear. Track your total in the trophy list itself, and per region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map's Exploration filter also lists found and completed stunt spots by name. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 — this trophy is a milestone on the way there, not the end of the grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says the trophy tracker counts 9 types, viewable under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and that most types are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map. In practice you will complete this without trying while working on the other trophies, so treat it as a free trophy and check the Activities menu only if it has not popped by the end of the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges and describes the gold medals as not too difficult. Work through them range by range after the story, when your weapons and focus are levelled up; each challenge is a short shooting drill, so the grind is repetition rather than difficulty. Not yet verified in game beyond PowerPyx's count: the 12 locations and 42 challenges are as PowerPyx lists them — based on the official description plus PowerPyx's guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 drone races exist in total, but only one win per location is needed). PowerPyx lists 14 locations and links a guide to all of them. Drone races are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None and count toward the race tally for Earn Cash, Not Kudos, so they overlap nicely with the rest of the racing grind. Do them after the story in free-roam, location by location, and tick each one off here as you win it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so re-winning the same race does not count twice. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in the game, so there is plenty of choice. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the activity types for Master of None, so mix them: win a spread of car races across the map and a few drone races, and this pops during the normal racing clean-up. The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many different wins you have.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text message that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map — follow Cal's fishing questline from there. PowerPyx describes the challenge as a head-to-head fishing contest against Cal at that marked spot. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and catching fish helps level your Focus, so it is worth doing when Cal's message arrives rather than leaving it for the end.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 in-game arcade games (called Video Games in game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. PowerPyx says the first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — available from Chapter 1, though temporarily unavailable during some story sections — while Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat all its challenges, so pick whichever you enjoy most and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 missions of Andy's optional questline, ending with Puff Puff Pass. The questline is exclusive to Lucia: during Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline on the map in Belville. PowerPyx lists the five quests as Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story, and PowerPyx notes that trophy-related quest givers who vanish temporarily always come back later, so there is no need to rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; a while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is then marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you to dive shipwrecks — 7 in total — marking purple treasure chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back to him. Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so the questline is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 missions of Billy's optional questline, ending with Hometown Heroes. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. PowerPyx lists the five quests as Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of Billy's quests stay available after the story, so you can clear them in free-roam if you prefer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but not every optional questline counts. PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and similar questlines do not count as strangers for this trophy, even though they have their own trophies. The strands PowerPyx confirms as counting are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street racing strand: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and package deliveries). Output Lag flags Yago's Race Against Yago as time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do that strand the moment it appears. Check the trophy's progress counter in the trophy list after each strand to confirm it counted.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner — that first car counts as delivered. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed locations and you can steal others off the street, with a popup when you scan or enter a car he wants. PowerPyx lists the cars (Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D) and notes they appear often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. The questline stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-quest storyline: Take Out Kitty Litter, then Spin On This. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is only available as Jason. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go there and destroy the labs. After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down, and the trophy pops when it is done. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — protect it in Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2, so always bring your partner. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The missable part: during Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony at Jason's house, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is strictly required for the trophy (the author had done it when the trophy popped). Do it anyway, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret Vogel asks for. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message — the questline is Jason-only). After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 target decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets — there are 18 sets in the game, so you only need a small fraction of the cards. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 set locations. Cards are found in the open world; work through the sets nearest to where you already are rather than hunting one set at a time, and the trophy will pop once your third set is complete. The cards are a collectible type that is only partly required by the 100% checklist, so you can stop at 3 sets unless you enjoy the hunt.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object. PowerPyx breaks the scannables down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — far more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. The habit to build is scanning everything unfamiliar as you travel: it also feeds Whip It Good (scanning vehicles) and the 100% checklist's vehicle and animal counts use the same scan-and-study tools. This is a pure volume trophy — no specific 100 locations are required.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx says the challenges are tracked under Progress, then Challenges, with a completed checkmark shown when you scroll over each one, and that many complete naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way to A Long Road — leave it for last, then pick the easiest and quickest of your remaining challenges to close the gap. With 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, you can skip the hardest ones entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops only after you drive out of the heat zone, not when you merely leave the flashing blue/red search area. This becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold right on the D-pad, then press Triangle). PowerPyx's easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, or driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels, so you may earn it without trying.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the stars fade, so keep the police chasing you the whole time. PowerPyx says the trophy unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store, ideally go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs, and do not leave the first store before the police arrive or the chain may not count. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix or Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation), and call your partner with hold-right then Triangle.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it, then hold R1 while looking at a vehicle to scan it — you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. PowerPyx says the game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes) and suggests standing on a busy road and scanning everything that passes. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there if you scan as you go.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-time aim activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm, which drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. PowerPyx's method: raise your focus first (eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline to extend the focus time), then line up 5 enemies — gang members at an illegal operation work well — and drop them quickly with an assault rifle like the Duke 556, which is more accurate and full-auto. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes the trophy does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you reach Focus level 4 this becomes much easier, and it may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and fly it away. PowerPyx is specific: planes parked on the airfield do not count — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, and the easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs next to the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. The trophy is delayed: you must fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it pops. Save first, because the police respond fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and the trophy pops once you are in it and shooting. PowerPyx says the tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, parked in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get into a tank and fire at enemies until it unlocks. The description's joke is the hint: Rhinos are the tanks. Save before you go in, since the base is heavily guarded.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (marked with green icons on the map in unfogged areas). Enter through the back door and use the Snap Gun when prompted; kicking the door triggers the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave — the trophy pops shortly after you exit. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. If anyone spots you, reload and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape — but note the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Bank vault robberies unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in quickly and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hand off a bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 for tips about security vans, marked with purple icons, after first doing his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans). Each vault robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The automatic way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — because robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck: tail the truck to the bank, get into the vault while it is open, take the cash and escape the heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. The earlier way: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way the trophy pops only after you have escaped the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. PowerPyx says the best way is by plane: fly over every area that is still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. This is a pure exploration trophy with no combat or collectible requirement — just coverage. Do it after the story when you have a fast plane and the whole map is open, and combine the flight with scanning vehicles and spotting animals for the other grind trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.countLabel: 1 operation for each of the 9 gangs
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy pops automatically while you clear them — you only need one per gang for the trophy itself. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar. PowerPyx describes it as a simple location trophy: the bar, the drink and the view are the whole requirement, and the trophy pops once you drink it there. Not yet verified in game beyond PowerPyx's description — based on the official description plus PowerPyx's guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car — the blue Banshee — from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight out through the showroom window. PowerPyx says you can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs: hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car — PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn — it is also one of the 39 illegal gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe. The three valuables are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the contents of the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. PowerPyx says the trophy is not missable: if you miss an item during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the remaining valuables.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your Strength level under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (heart icon). This becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. PowerPyx's method: buy a membership at a fitness club and always train together — call your partner (hold right on the D-pad, then press Triangle) — because while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training too, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City and can be filtered on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.countLabel: 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the PSN tracker counts up to 500, and you can view your count by selecting the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action changes your reputation. Actions fall into styles: Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (a permanent status from excessive violence — avoid it, as cops become more aggressive). This fills up passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so you will very likely earn it while working on the other trophies. If it is still short at the end, PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in game — based on the official description plus PowerPyx's guide. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 November 2026. Do not chase it specifically: play normally, do the Payday Loans content when it appears, and check back — this guide will be updated when a source confirms the method. The sources below are where the current information comes from.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx describes it in detail: go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo — the event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. Because the spawn is random, this may take a few attempts on different nights.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet verified in game — based on the official description plus PowerPyx's guide. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, as the description says. No guide has confirmed the exact conditions as of 19 November 2026, so the practical advice is: while riding a motorcycle, try melee attacks against enemies on foot and see if it registers. Do not grind it blindly; the sources below are where the current information comes from, and this guide will be updated when a source confirms the method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences) — the total is cumulative, you do not need $250,000 at once. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone can give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…. This comes naturally while doing all the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal play contributes all the way. PowerPyx says the fastest way is buying guns, car mods and tattoos, which are the most expensive items. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. You will likely pass $100,000 naturally while gearing up for the other trophies; if you are short at the end, spend the surplus on weapon mods and tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that a new app has been installed on your phone: Vice City Real Estate. Buy the garages through that phone app; together they cost a total of $160,000. PowerPyx notes the fastest way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones that unlock in Chapters 3–4. Buying garages also adds parking spots you need for On the Spot, so do this trophy before registering vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes), because each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
